environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to COUNT (not block), (2) a custom rule group 'corp-uri-allowlist' that uses a regex pattern set matching ^/api/users/[0-9]+$ and ^/health$ with ALLOW action and default BLOCK for non-matching URIs, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet in default BLOCK mode with sensitivity level HIGH. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics enabled per-rule. The ECS task role has no S3 or SSM permissions. Container runs with read-only root filesystem except /var/lib/app/ which is an EFS mount.

config.network: private subnet, no IGW, NAT gateway for egress
